description: Outage summary, service incidents, separate carrier status and one row per network outage, full non-network provider list, then collection and incident details.

panels.description: Reported degradation or outages across enabled providers. Maintenance is separate. Incomplete data is shown explicitly when no outage is reported.

targets.rawSql:
WITH incident_health AS (
    SELECT provider_id, MAX(CASE impact WHEN 'major_outage' THEN 5 WHEN 'partial_outage' THEN 4
        WHEN 'degraded' THEN 3 WHEN 'unknown' THEN 2 WHEN 'maintenance' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severity
    FROM external_status.active_incidents
    WHERE lifecycle <> 'scheduled' AND started_at <= now()
    GROUP BY provider_id
), provider_health AS (
    SELECT p.*, CASE GREATEST(CASE p.effective_status WHEN 'major_outage' THEN 5 WHEN 'partial_outage' THEN 4
        WHEN 'degraded' THEN 3 WHEN 'unknown' THEN 2 WHEN 'maintenance' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, COALESCE(i.severity, 0))
        WHEN 5 THEN 'major_outage' WHEN 4 THEN 'partial_outage' WHEN 3 THEN 'degraded'
        WHEN 2 THEN 'unknown' WHEN 1 THEN 'maintenance' ELSE 'operational' END AS reported_status
    FROM external_status.provider_current p LEFT JOIN incident_health i ON i.provider_id = p.id
)
SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM provider_health WHERE reported_status IN ('degraded', 'partial_outage', 'major_outage')) THEN 1
    WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM provider_health WHERE stale OR reported_status = 'unknown' OR consecutive_failures > 0) THEN 2
    ELSE 0 END AS "Outage status";

panels.title: Providers with an outage

panels.description: Current outages for service providers, excluding carriers. Each incident has its own row, with the provider logo, affected service, status and source link.

targets.rawSql:
WITH incident_health AS (
    SELECT provider_id, MAX(CASE impact WHEN 'major_outage' THEN 5 WHEN 'partial_outage' THEN 4
        WHEN 'degraded' THEN 3 WHEN 'unknown' THEN 2 WHEN 'maintenance' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severity
    FROM external_status.active_incidents
    WHERE lifecycle <> 'scheduled' AND started_at <= now()
    GROUP BY provider_id
), provider_health AS (
    SELECT p.*, CASE GREATEST(CASE p.effective_status WHEN 'major_outage' THEN 5 WHEN 'partial_outage' THEN 4
        WHEN 'degraded' THEN 3 WHEN 'unknown' THEN 2 WHEN 'maintenance' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, COALESCE(i.severity, 0))
        WHEN 5 THEN 'major_outage' WHEN 4 THEN 'partial_outage' WHEN 3 THEN 'degraded'
        WHEN 2 THEN 'unknown' WHEN 1 THEN 'maintenance' ELSE 'operational' END AS reported_status
    FROM external_status.provider_current p LEFT JOIN incident_health i ON i.provider_id = p.id
), issues AS (
    SELECT CASE WHEN c.domain <> '' THEN 'https://www.google.com/s2/favicons?domain_url=https://' || c.domain || '&sz=64' END AS "Icon", p.name AS "Provider", 
        COALESCE(affected.names, 'Provider-wide / not specified') AS "Affected service / area",
        COALESCE(incident.title, 'Provider reports ' || replace(p.reported_status, '_', ' ')) AS "Issue",
        COALESCE(incident.impact, p.reported_status) AS "Status",
        COALESCE(incident.lifecycle, 'provider_status') AS "Stage", incident.started_at AS "Started",
        p.last_success_at AS "Last checked", COALESCE(incident.source_url, NULLIF(c.status_url, '')) AS "Source"
    FROM provider_health p JOIN external_status.sources c USING (id)
    LEFT JOIN external_status.active_incidents incident ON incident.provider_id = p.id
        AND incident.impact IN ('degraded', 'partial_outage', 'major_outage')
        AND incident.lifecycle <> 'scheduled' AND incident.started_at <= now()
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT component.name, ', ' ORDER BY component.name) AS names
        FROM external_status.components component WHERE component.provider_id = p.id AND component.active
        AND ((incident.external_id IS NOT NULL AND component.external_id = ANY(incident.affected_component_ids))
            OR (incident.external_id IS NULL AND component.current_status IN ('degraded', 'partial_outage', 'major_outage')))
    ) affected ON TRUE
    WHERE p.category <> 'carriers' AND p.reported_status IN ('degraded', 'partial_outage', 'major_outage')
), display_rows AS (
    SELECT * FROM issues
    UNION ALL SELECT NULL::text, 'No reported service outages', 
        ''::text, 'No reported service incidents', 'operational', ''::text, NULL::timestamptz, NULL::timestamptz, NULL::text
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM issues)
)
SELECT * FROM display_rows ORDER BY CASE "Status" WHEN 'major_outage' THEN 5 WHEN 'partial_outage' THEN 4 ELSE 3 END DESC,
    "Provider", "Started" DESC, "Issue";

panels.title: Service outages — what is affected

panels.description: Current status and collection freshness for each selected carrier. Network outage cases are listed separately below; regional incidents do not imply a nationwide outage.

targets.rawSql:
WITH incident_health AS (
    SELECT provider_id, MAX(CASE impact WHEN 'major_outage' THEN 5 WHEN 'partial_outage' THEN 4
        WHEN 'degraded' THEN 3 WHEN 'unknown' THEN 2 WHEN 'maintenance' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severity
    FROM external_status.active_incidents
    WHERE lifecycle <> 'scheduled' AND started_at <= now()
    GROUP BY provider_id
), provider_health AS (
    SELECT p.*, CASE GREATEST(CASE p.effective_status WHEN 'major_outage' THEN 5 WHEN 'partial_outage' THEN 4
        WHEN 'degraded' THEN 3 WHEN 'unknown' THEN 2 WHEN 'maintenance' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, COALESCE(i.severity, 0))
        WHEN 5 THEN 'major_outage' WHEN 4 THEN 'partial_outage' WHEN 3 THEN 'degraded'
        WHEN 2 THEN 'unknown' WHEN 1 THEN 'maintenance' ELSE 'operational' END AS reported_status
    FROM external_status.provider_current p LEFT JOIN incident_health i ON i.provider_id = p.id
)
SELECT CASE WHEN c.domain <> '' THEN 'https://www.google.com/s2/favicons?domain_url=https://' || c.domain || '&sz=64' END AS "Icon", p.name AS "Provider", p.reported_status AS "Status",
    CASE WHEN p.last_success_at IS NULL THEN 'Not checked' WHEN p.stale THEN 'Stale'
        WHEN p.consecutive_failures > 0 THEN 'Poll failing' WHEN c.collection_mode = 'public_advisory' THEN 'Public info only' ELSE 'Fresh' END AS "Collection",
    p.last_success_at AS "Last checked", c.status_url AS "Source"
FROM provider_health p JOIN external_status.sources c USING (id)
WHERE p.category = 'carriers' AND p.id IN (${network:sqlstring}) ORDER BY p.name;

panels.title: Network provider status

panels.description: Markers use published area coordinates, not customer addresses. Overlapping reports are grouped; marker size shows report count and colour shows worst impact. Hover for provider, area, affected service and issues. Reports without coordinates remain in the table below.

targets.rawSql:
WITH points AS (
    SELECT i.provider_id, i.external_id, s.name AS provider, i.title AS issue,
        CASE i.impact WHEN 'major_outage' THEN 5 WHEN 'partial_outage' THEN 4 ELSE 3 END AS severity,
        point->>'name' AS location, point->>'precision' AS precision,
        (point->>'latitude')::double precision AS latitude,
        (point->>'longitude')::double precision AS longitude,
        array_to_string(ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(to_jsonb(i)->'network_details'->'services', '[]'::jsonb))), ', ') AS services
    FROM external_status.active_incidents i JOIN external_status.sources s ON s.id = i.provider_id
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(to_jsonb(i)->'network_details'->'locations', '[]'::jsonb)) point
    WHERE s.enabled AND s.category = 'carriers' AND i.provider_id IN (${network:sqlstring})
        AND i.impact IN ('degraded', 'partial_outage', 'major_outage')
        AND i.lifecycle <> 'scheduled' AND i.started_at <= now()
        AND NOT (i.provider_id = 'telia' AND i.external_id LIKE 'TV-%')
), valid AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT * FROM points WHERE latitude BETWEEN -90 AND 90 AND longitude BETWEEN -180 AND 180
), ranked AS (
    SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY provider_id, latitude, longitude ORDER BY severity DESC, external_id) AS position
    FROM valid
)
SELECT latitude AS "Latitude", longitude AS "Longitude", provider AS "Provider",
    string_agg(DISTINCT location, ', ') AS "Location", string_agg(DISTINCT services, ', ') AS "Affected service",
    COUNT(DISTINCT external_id)::bigint AS "Reports", MAX(severity)::double precision AS "Severity",
    string_agg(external_id || ': ' || issue, E'\n' ORDER BY severity DESC, external_id) FILTER (WHERE position <= 3) AS "Issues",
    CASE WHEN bool_or(precision = 'area_center') THEN 'Approximate centre of a provider-published area'
        ELSE 'Provider-published point' END AS "Location precision"
FROM ranked GROUP BY provider_id, provider, latitude, longitude ORDER BY provider, latitude, longitude;

panels.title: Network outage map — published affected areas

panels.description: One row per network outage, with separate location, affected service, fault description and map/report link. County viewport labels and bounding-box centres are approximate; exact addresses and causes are shown only when the provider publishes them. TV-only Telia cases are excluded.

value.title: Open affected area or provider report

targets.rawSql:
WITH incident_health AS (
    SELECT provider_id, MAX(CASE impact WHEN 'major_outage' THEN 5 WHEN 'partial_outage' THEN 4
        WHEN 'degraded' THEN 3 WHEN 'unknown' THEN 2 WHEN 'maintenance' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severity
    FROM external_status.active_incidents
    WHERE lifecycle <> 'scheduled' AND started_at <= now()
    GROUP BY provider_id
), provider_health AS (
    SELECT p.*, CASE GREATEST(CASE p.effective_status WHEN 'major_outage' THEN 5 WHEN 'partial_outage' THEN 4
        WHEN 'degraded' THEN 3 WHEN 'unknown' THEN 2 WHEN 'maintenance' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, COALESCE(i.severity, 0))
        WHEN 5 THEN 'major_outage' WHEN 4 THEN 'partial_outage' WHEN 3 THEN 'degraded'
        WHEN 2 THEN 'unknown' WHEN 1 THEN 'maintenance' ELSE 'operational' END AS reported_status
    FROM external_status.provider_current p LEFT JOIN incident_health i ON i.provider_id = p.id
), issues AS (
    SELECT CASE WHEN c.domain <> '' THEN 'https://www.google.com/s2/favicons?domain_url=https://' || c.domain || '&sz=64' END AS "Icon",
        p.name AS "Provider", incident.external_id AS "Case",
        COALESCE(affected.locations, 'Not published by provider') AS "Location",
        COALESCE(affected.services, 'Network / telephony') AS "Affected service",
        COALESCE(regexp_replace(incident.title, '^((BB|BT|TV)-[0-9]+|[0-9]+): *', ''),
            'Provider reports ' || replace(p.reported_status, '_', ' ')) AS "Issue",
        COALESCE(incident.impact, p.reported_status) AS "Status",
        COALESCE(incident.lifecycle, 'provider_status') AS "Stage", incident.started_at AS "Started",
        p.last_success_at AS "Last checked",
        CASE WHEN incident.source_url LIKE 'https://www.openstreetmap.org/%'
               OR incident.source_url LIKE 'https://glu2.han.telia.se/bios/glup/glup.html?%' THEN 'Map'
             ELSE 'Provider report' END AS "Map / report",
        COALESCE(incident.source_url, NULLIF(c.status_url, '')) AS "Source", c.status_url AS "Provider source"
    FROM provider_health p JOIN external_status.sources c USING (id)
    LEFT JOIN external_status.active_incidents incident ON incident.provider_id = p.id
        AND incident.impact IN ('degraded', 'partial_outage', 'major_outage')
        AND incident.lifecycle <> 'scheduled' AND incident.started_at <= now()
        AND NOT (p.id = 'telia' AND incident.external_id LIKE 'TV-%')
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT regexp_replace(component.name, ' / [^/]+$', ''), ', ' ORDER BY regexp_replace(component.name, ' / [^/]+$', ''))
                FILTER (WHERE component.name LIKE '% / %') AS locations,
            string_agg(DISTINCT regexp_replace(component.name, '^.* / ', ''), ', ' ORDER BY regexp_replace(component.name, '^.* / ', '')) AS services
        FROM external_status.components component WHERE component.provider_id = p.id AND component.active
            AND component.name !~* ' / (TV|IPTV)$'
            AND ((incident.external_id IS NOT NULL AND component.external_id = ANY(incident.affected_component_ids))
                OR (incident.external_id IS NULL AND component.current_status IN ('degraded', 'partial_outage', 'major_outage')))
    ) affected ON TRUE
    WHERE p.category = 'carriers' AND p.id IN (${network:sqlstring})
        AND p.reported_status IN ('degraded', 'partial_outage', 'major_outage')
        AND NOT (p.id = 'telia' AND incident.external_id IS NULL AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM external_status.active_incidents i WHERE i.provider_id = p.id AND i.external_id LIKE 'TV-%'))
), display_rows AS (
    SELECT * FROM issues UNION ALL
    SELECT NULL::text, 'No reported network outages', NULL::text, ''::text, ''::text, 'No reported service incidents',
        'operational', ''::text, NULL::timestamptz, NULL::timestamptz, ''::text, NULL::text, NULL::text
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM issues)
)
SELECT * FROM display_rows ORDER BY CASE "Status" WHEN 'major_outage' THEN 5 WHEN 'partial_outage' THEN 4 ELSE 3 END DESC,
    "Provider", "Location", "Started" DESC, "Case";

panels.title: Network outages — issue, location and service

panels.description: Every enabled non-network provider in one alphabetical list. No pagination or SQL row limit. Carriers are listed separately above. Status includes active incidents and component health.

targets.rawSql:
WITH incident_health AS (
    SELECT provider_id, MAX(CASE impact WHEN 'major_outage' THEN 5 WHEN 'partial_outage' THEN 4
        WHEN 'degraded' THEN 3 WHEN 'unknown' THEN 2 WHEN 'maintenance' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS severity
    FROM external_status.active_incidents
    WHERE lifecycle <> 'scheduled' AND started_at <= now()
    GROUP BY provider_id
), provider_health AS (
    SELECT p.*, CASE GREATEST(CASE p.effective_status WHEN 'major_outage' THEN 5 WHEN 'partial_outage' THEN 4
        WHEN 'degraded' THEN 3 WHEN 'unknown' THEN 2 WHEN 'maintenance' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, COALESCE(i.severity, 0))
        WHEN 5 THEN 'major_outage' WHEN 4 THEN 'partial_outage' WHEN 3 THEN 'degraded'
        WHEN 2 THEN 'unknown' WHEN 1 THEN 'maintenance' ELSE 'operational' END AS reported_status
    FROM external_status.provider_current p LEFT JOIN incident_health i ON i.provider_id = p.id
)
SELECT CASE WHEN c.domain <> '' THEN 'https://www.google.com/s2/favicons?domain_url=https://' || c.domain || '&sz=64' END AS "Icon", p.name AS "Provider", c.dependency AS "Used for", p.reported_status AS "Status",
    CASE WHEN p.last_success_at IS NULL THEN 'Not checked' WHEN p.stale THEN 'Stale'
        WHEN p.consecutive_failures > 0 THEN 'Poll failing' WHEN c.collection_mode = 'public_advisory' THEN 'Public info only' ELSE 'Fresh' END AS "Collection",
    p.last_success_at AS "Last checked", COALESCE(p.last_error, '') AS "Detail", c.coverage AS "Coverage", c.status_url AS "Source"
FROM provider_health p JOIN external_status.sources c USING (id) WHERE p.category <> 'carriers' ORDER BY p.name;

panels.title: All service providers — complete status list

panels.description: Network/API collector success during the selected range. Manual reports are excluded. Success rates use a fixed 0–100% scale.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s.name AS "Provider", COUNT(*) AS "Checks",
 ROUND(100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN a.succeeded THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 1) AS "Success rate",
 MAX(a.checked_at) AS "Last check"
FROM external_status.poll_attempts a JOIN external_status.sources s ON s.id = a.source_id
WHERE s.enabled AND s.collection_mode NOT IN ('manual', 'public_advisory') AND $__timeFilter(a.checked_at)
GROUP BY s.id, s.name ORDER BY "Success rate", s.name;

panels.title: Automatic collection reliability

panels.description: Current unresolved incidents and the latest lifecycle reported by each provider.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    source.name AS "Provider",
    incident.title AS "Incident",
    incident.lifecycle AS "Lifecycle",
    incident.impact AS "Impact",
    incident.started_at AS "Started",
    incident.provider_updated_at AS "Updated",
    incident.source_url AS "Source"
FROM external_status.active_incidents AS incident
JOIN external_status.sources AS source ON source.id = incident.provider_id
ORDER BY incident.provider_updated_at DESC;

panels.title: Incident details and source links

panels.description: Provider observations connected between checks. Gaps beyond each source freshness threshold become Unknown; hover to read the normalized state.

targets.rawSql:
WITH samples AS (
 SELECT o.provider_id, s.name, o.observed_at, s.stale_after_seconds,
  LEAD(o.observed_at) OVER (PARTITION BY o.provider_id ORDER BY o.observed_at) AS next_at,
  CASE o.status WHEN 'operational' THEN 0 WHEN 'maintenance' THEN 1 WHEN 'unknown' THEN 2
   WHEN 'degraded' THEN 3 WHEN 'partial_outage' THEN 4 WHEN 'major_outage' THEN 5 ELSE 2 END::double precision AS value
 FROM external_status.provider_observations o JOIN external_status.sources s ON s.id = o.provider_id
 WHERE s.enabled AND s.collection_mode <> 'public_advisory' AND $__timeFilter(o.observed_at)
), states AS (
 SELECT observed_at AS "time", name AS metric, value FROM samples
 UNION ALL
 SELECT observed_at + stale_after_seconds * interval '1 second', name, 2::double precision
 FROM samples WHERE observed_at + stale_after_seconds * interval '1 second' < COALESCE(next_at, now())
)
SELECT * FROM states WHERE $__timeFilter("time") ORDER BY "time";

panels.title: Service history

panels.description: Worst state per provider/component name; duplicate regional entries are grouped with their instance count. Limited to 250 rows; select a provider for detail.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT source.name AS "Provider", component.name AS "Component",
 CASE MAX(CASE component.current_status WHEN 'operational' THEN 0 WHEN 'maintenance' THEN 1
  WHEN 'unknown' THEN 2 WHEN 'degraded' THEN 3 WHEN 'partial_outage' THEN 4 WHEN 'major_outage' THEN 5 ELSE 2 END)
 WHEN 0 THEN 'operational' WHEN 1 THEN 'maintenance' WHEN 2 THEN 'unknown'
 WHEN 3 THEN 'degraded' WHEN 4 THEN 'partial_outage' ELSE 'major_outage' END AS "Status",
 COUNT(*) AS "Reported instances", MAX(component.provider_updated_at) AS "Provider updated"
FROM external_status.components component JOIN external_status.sources source ON source.id = component.provider_id
WHERE source.enabled AND component.active AND component.provider_id ~ '^${provider:regex}$'
GROUP BY source.name, component.name
ORDER BY MAX(CASE component.current_status WHEN 'operational' THEN 0 WHEN 'maintenance' THEN 1
 WHEN 'unknown' THEN 2 WHEN 'degraded' THEN 3 WHEN 'partial_outage' THEN 4 WHEN 'major_outage' THEN 5 ELSE 2 END) DESC,
 source.name, component.name LIMIT 250;

panels.title: Component state

panels.description: Recent successful and failed collection attempts for the selected providers.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    checked_at AS "Checked",
    source_id AS "Source",
    succeeded AS "Succeeded",
    COALESCE(error, '') AS "Error"
FROM external_status.poll_attempts
WHERE $__timeFilter(checked_at)
  AND source_id ~ '^${provider:regex}$'
ORDER BY checked_at DESC
LIMIT 100;

options.content: Start with **Any outages?** and **Service outages**. **Network provider status** and **Network outages** are separate: every carrier case has its own row with the affected area or service. Use **Network provider** to focus on Telia or another carrier. **All service providers** lists every non-network provider without pagination. Unknown or stale means health could not be established. Green means no issue reported within the stated public coverage. Maintenance and unconfirmed advisories remain in Incident details. The Provider filter applies to component and poll details. The network map groups cases at published coordinates. Area-centre markers are approximate; text-only reports are listed below without guessed pins.
